cli.description: MimikkAi Coding Plan Helper for managing coding tools

init.selectTool: Select a coding tool to configure:
init.toolNotInstalledWarn: ⚠️  {{tool}} is not installed — the configuration was written, but the tool cannot use it. Install {{tool}} and re-run setup.
init.unboundSummary:
{{tool}} is not bound to MimikkAi.
  The MimikkAi account (global key) remains bound — revoke fully with: mimikkai-connect auth revoke
init.unbindNothing: No MimikkAi configuration found for {{tool}} — nothing to remove.
init.overwriteForeignAsk: {{tool}} is currently configured for a different provider.
init.overwriteCancelled: {{tool}} setup cancelled — the existing configuration was left untouched.

lang.help:
Show or set the UI language.

Usage:
  mimikkai-connect lang show
  mimikkai-connect lang set <code>   (en_US, ru_RU)

auth.help:
Manage authentication with mimikkai.ru.

Usage:
  mimikkai-connect auth                                    Interactively authenticate
  mimikkai-connect auth glm_coding_plan_global <token>     Set key directly (Global plan alias)
  mimikkai-connect auth glm_coding_plan_china <token>      Set key directly (China plan alias)
  mimikkai-connect auth revoke                             Delete the saved key
  mimikkai-connect auth reload claude                      Load latest plan info into Claude Code
auth.methodDevice: Open a browser and confirm a device code (recommended)
auth.deviceCode: Enter this code in the browser: {{code}}
auth.deviceExpired: The device code has expired. Please try again.
auth.litellmKeyMissing: Could not retrieve the LiteLLM key for your account. Agents cannot be configured.
auth.noKey: No saved key found. Run `mimikkai-connect auth` first.
